airbnb-host-tracker.name: Short-Term Rental Host Tracker
airbnb-host-tracker.etsyTitle: Airbnb Host Spreadsheet, Short Term Rental Income & Expense Tracker, Occupancy, ADR & RevPAR, Vrbo, Excel & Google Sheets
airbnb-host-tracker.intro: Built for short-term rental hosts with one to eight listings. Log each stay once - nights, gross and payout calculate themselves - and the dashboard shows occupancy, average nightly rate (ADR), RevPAR and profit per listing.
features: Bookings log: listing, platform, guest, dates, rate, cleaning fee, platform fee
Occupancy by listing and month, split correctly across month ends
KPIs: payout, expenses, profit, occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, nights booked
Payout by platform (Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com, direct)
Expenses per listing, with shared costs spread across listings
Cancelled stays drop out of every total automatically

sheets.name: Dashboard
sheets.what: payout, profit, occupancy, ADR, RevPAR and per-listing results

sheets.name: Bookings
sheets.what: every stay

sheets.name: Expenses
sheets.what: every cost by listing

sheets.name: Occupancy
sheets.what: nights booked and occupancy % by listing and month

sheets.name: Settings
sheets.what: listings, platforms and categories

steps: Settings: currency, year, and up to 8 listings (name and your usual cleaning fee). Edit platforms and expense categories if you like.
Bookings: one row per stay - listing, platform, guest, check-in, check-out, nightly rate, cleaning fee and the platform's fee. Nights, gross and payout calculate themselves.
Expenses: log every cost against a listing (or "All" for shared costs).

Dashboard shows payout, profit, occupancy, average nightly rate and RevPAR for the year, plus each listing's results. Occupancy breaks nights down month by month - stays that cross a month end are split correctly.
Delete the sample bookings and expenses before you start.
tips: Platform fee = what Airbnb / Vrbo keep (host service fee). Payout = what reaches your bank.
Mark cancelled stays as Cancelled instead of deleting them - they drop out of every total, and any payout you still received can go in Other fees.
ADR = average nightly rate on booked nights. RevPAR = revenue per available night - the best single number for comparing listings.
Works for Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com and direct bookings in any currency. Not tax advice.

annual-budget-planner.name: Annual Budget Planner 2027
annual-budget-planner.etsyTitle: 2027 Budget Planner Spreadsheet, Excel & Google Sheets Monthly Budget Template, Easy Annual Budget Tracker with Dashboard
annual-budget-planner.intro: A simple, good-looking budget for the whole of 2027. Type your transactions once and the dashboard shows - for any month you pick - what came in, what went out, what you saved and what's left to spend, category by category.
features: Monthly dashboard with a month picker: income, expenses, savings, left to spend and savings rate
Budget vs actual for up to 30 categories, with progress bars and red/green differences
Annual summary: every category across 12 months, plus running bank balance
Charts: spending by type and income vs expenses for the year
Transactions log for 600 entries with category dropdowns
Category types (Income, Fixed, Variable, Savings, Debt) so totals sort themselves

sheets.what: currency, year, opening balance and your categories

sheets.name: Budget
sheets.what: planned amount per category for each month

sheets.what: your income and spending log

sheets.name: Dashboard
sheets.what: one month at a glance: budget vs actual, charts, what's left

sheets.name: Annual Summary
sheets.what: every category across all 12 months, with yearly totals and savings rate

steps: Go to Settings: pick your currency symbol, the year and your opening bank balance.
Edit the category list in Settings (up to 30). Give each one a type: Income, Fixed, Variable, Savings or Debt.
On Budget, type how much you plan for each category each month. Copy one month across with copy/paste if it never changes.
Log every income and expense on Transactions: date, description, category (dropdown) and amount. Always enter amounts as positive numbers - the category type decides whether it is money in or out.
Open Dashboard and pick a month in the yellow box. Annual Summary shows the whole year at once.
Clear the sample data first: select the white cells on Transactions (columns B-E) and on Budget and press Delete.
tips: Works in any currency - the symbol you choose in Settings appears on every label.
Left to spend = income - expenses - savings. Red means you spent more than you earned that month.
Rename a category in Settings and every sheet updates. If you rename one that already has transactions, update those rows too (Find & Replace).
Need more rows? Transactions holds 600 entries. Insert extra rows above the last one so the formulas expand with them.

debt-payoff-planner.name: Debt Payoff Planner
debt-payoff-planner.etsyTitle: Debt Payoff Planner Spreadsheet, Snowball & Avalanche Debt Tracker, Excel & Google Sheets, Debt Free Date Calculator
debt-payoff-planner.intro: List your debts and an extra amount you can pay each month. The planner works out your debt-free date, the total interest, and how much faster you finish than paying minimums only - comparing the snowball and avalanche methods side by side.
features: Debt-free date, months to go and interest saved
Snowball, avalanche and minimum-only compared in one table
Month-by-month payment schedule for up to 30 years, payoff months highlighted
Payoff order with the date each debt is cleared
Warns you if a minimum payment doesn't cover the interest
Balance-over-time chart for all three strategies

sheets.name: Dashboard
sheets.what: debt-free date, interest, strategy comparison and payoff chart

sheets.name: Debts
sheets.what: your settings and debt list - the only place you type

sheets.name: Schedule
sheets.what: month-by-month payment plan for your chosen strategy

steps: Open Debts. Set your currency, the month of your first payment and any extra money you can add each month on top of the minimums.
List up to 10 debts: name, current balance, interest rate (APR) and minimum monthly payment. Replace the sample debts.
Choose a strategy: Snowball (smallest balance first, quick wins) or Avalanche (highest interest first, least interest overall).
Dashboard shows your debt-free date, total interest and how much faster you finish than paying minimums only - for both strategies side by side.
Schedule lists every month: what to pay on each debt and the balance left. Tick a debt off as you go and update balances every few months.
tips: When a debt is paid off, its minimum payment rolls onto the next debt automatically - that's what makes snowball and avalanche work.
APR is the yearly interest rate on your statement, e.g. 22.9%. Enter 0% for interest-free debts.
If your minimum payment is less than the monthly interest, that debt never shrinks - the sheet shows "30+ yrs" so you can spot it.
Results are estimates: lenders calculate interest daily and fees can apply. Re-enter real balances every few months to stay accurate.

etsy-seller-profit-tracker.name: Etsy Seller Profit Tracker
etsy-seller-profit-tracker.etsyTitle: Etsy Seller Spreadsheet, Etsy Fee Calculator & Profit Tracker, Pricing Calculator, Excel & Google Sheets Shop Bookkeeping
etsy-seller-profit-tracker.intro: Find out what you actually keep. The pricing calculator shows the real profit on each product after transaction fees, payment processing, listing fees, materials, packaging and postage - and suggests a price for the margin you want. The sales log works out fees and profit on every order, including Offsite Ads.
features: Pricing calculator with suggested price for your target margin
Per-order fees: transaction, payment processing, listing renewal and Offsite Ads (capped at 100)
Cost of goods per product: materials, packaging, postage, your time
Dashboard: revenue, fees, costs, profit, margin, best products, monthly chart
Shop costs log for ads, subscriptions and bulk supplies
Works for physical and digital products

steps: Settings: check the Etsy fee rates for your country (they're preset to the standard US rates) and your hourly rate.

Pricing: add each product with its price, material and packaging cost, the postage you pay and minutes of work. You instantly see Etsy fees, real profit and margin per sale - and a suggested price for your target margin.
Sales: log orders (date, product, quantity, price, shipping charged, discount, and whether it came from Offsite Ads). Fees and profit calculate per order.
Costs: log shop costs that aren't per order - Etsy Ads, listing renewals, supplies in bulk, subscriptions.
Dashboard shows revenue, every fee, costs, true profit, best products and month-by-month results.
Delete the sample products, sales and costs when you start.
tips: Fees are estimates from the rates in Settings. Check your monthly Etsy statement and adjust the rates if your country differs.
Offsite Ads: tick Yes for orders Etsy marks as coming from Offsite Ads - the 15% (or 12%) fee is added to that order.
Digital product? Leave materials and postage at 0 - the tracker still accounts for Etsy's fees.
Not affiliated with Etsy, Inc. Etsy is a trademark of Etsy, Inc.

inventory-tracker.name: Inventory and Stock Tracker
inventory-tracker.etsyTitle: Inventory Tracker Spreadsheet, Stock Management Template, Low Stock Alerts, Excel & Google Sheets, Small Business Inventory
inventory-tracker.intro: A clear inventory system for makers and small shops. Add your products once, log every restock, sale, return or breakage, and see live stock, stock value and what needs reordering.
features: Live stock per product from a simple movements log
Status for every item: OK, Low, Reorder or Out of stock - colour-coded
Reorder list and best-sellers on the dashboard
Stock value at cost and retail, margin per product
Up to 200 products and 1,500 stock movements
Duplicate-SKU and unknown-SKU warnings

sheets.what: stock value, items to reorder, best sellers, value by category

sheets.name: Products
sheets.what: your catalogue with live stock levels and status

sheets.name: Stock Moves
sheets.what: every restock, sale, return and correction

sheets.name: Settings
sheets.what: currency, categories, suppliers

steps: Settings: choose your currency and edit the category and supplier lists.
Products: add each item once - SKU (a short unique code), name, category, supplier, unit cost, sale price, reorder point and the stock you have today (opening stock).

Stock Moves: every time stock changes, add a row - date, SKU (dropdown), type (restock, sale, return, damaged, count correction) and quantity. Always type quantities as positive numbers, except count corrections where you type + or -.
Products then shows live stock, value and a status: OK, Low, Reorder or Out of stock. Dashboard lists what to reorder and your best sellers.
Delete the sample products and moves (white cells) before adding your own.
tips: Reorder point = the stock level at which you should order more. Reorder qty = how many you usually order.
Low = within 25% above the reorder point, so you get an early warning.
Do a stock count every month or two and fix differences with a Count correction row - your history stays intact.
Selling on Etsy, Shopify or at markets? Log sales daily or weekly in one batch per SKU to keep it quick.

paycheck-budget-planner.name: Paycheck Budget Planner
paycheck-budget-planner.etsyTitle: Paycheck Budget Spreadsheet, Biweekly Budget Template Excel & Google Sheets, Bill Tracker by Paycheck, Simple Bill Planner
paycheck-budget-planner.intro: Stop guessing which bills come out of which check. Enter your take-home pay, how often you're paid and your bills with their due days - the planner matches every bill to the paycheck that lands before it's due and shows what you can safely spend.
features: "This Paycheck" view: the exact bills to pay from any paycheck, with due dates
Paycheck Plan for the whole year: pay, extra income, bills, savings and left to spend
Short paychecks highlighted in red so you can plan ahead
Weekly, biweekly, twice a month or monthly pay
Up to 30 bills, any due day (handles 29th-31st in short months)
Chart of left-to-spend across every paycheck

sheets.name: This Paycheck

sheets.name: Paycheck Plan
sheets.what: every paycheck of the year at a glance

sheets.name: Setup
sheets.what: your pay, payday and bills - the only typing you do

steps: Setup: type what you take home each payday, how often you're paid and your next payday.
List your bills with the amount and the day of the month each one is due. That's all the typing.
This Paycheck: pick a paycheck number and see exactly which bills to pay from it - and what's left to spend.
Paycheck Plan shows the whole year, one row per paycheck. Add any extra income or change savings for a single check there.
tips: Bills are matched to the last paycheck that arrives before their due date, so the money is there in time.
Paid on the 1st and 15th? Choose "Twice a month". Every other Friday? Choose "Every 2 weeks".
Red left-over means that paycheck is short - move a bill's due date or shift some savings to another check.

rental-property-manager.name: Rental Property Manager
rental-property-manager.etsyTitle: Rental Property Spreadsheet, Landlord Tracker for Rent, Tenants & Expenses, Rent Roll Template, Excel & Google Sheets
rental-property-manager.intro: A landlord workbook that keeps rent, tenants and costs in order. Log rent as it arrives and the rent roll shows, for every tenant and month, whether rent is paid in full (green), part-paid (amber) or missing (red).
features: Rent roll: every tenant x every month, colour-coded
Tenants & leases with Active / Ending soon / Ended status
Expenses by property and category (mortgage, repairs, tax, insurance...)
Per-property rent, expenses, cash flow and cap rate
Portfolio KPIs: rent collected, expenses, cash flow, occupancy, equity
Up to 10 properties and 30 leases

sheets.name: Dashboard
sheets.what: cash flow, occupancy, equity, per-property results and leases ending soon

sheets.what: your portfolio

sheets.what: every rent payment received

sheets.name: Settings
sheets.what: currency, year, expense categories

steps: Settings: currency, year, and the expense categories you want to track.
Properties: list each property once with its value, loan balance and monthly mortgage payment.
Tenants: one row per lease - property, unit, tenant, monthly rent, due day, deposit and lease dates. Status warns you 60 days before a lease ends.
Rent Ledger: log each rent payment and pick the month it pays for. Rent Roll then shows who has paid each month: green paid, amber part-paid, red missing.
Expenses: log every cost against a property. Dashboard shows cash flow, occupancy, equity and per-property results.
Delete the sample rows (white cells) when you're ready to start.
tips: Log mortgage payments as an expense (category Mortgage payment) so cash flow is real money in minus real money out.
Cap rate = (rent - operating expenses, excluding mortgage) / current value. It's for comparing properties, not a valuation.
Works for houses, apartments, rooms or garages - a "unit" is anything you rent out separately.
This is a record-keeping tool, not tax or legal advice.

savings-challenge-tracker.name: Savings Challenge Tracker
savings-challenge-tracker.etsyTitle: Savings Challenge Tracker Spreadsheet, 100 Envelope Challenge, 52 Week Savings Challenge, Savings Goals, Excel Google Sheets
savings-challenge-tracker.intro: Make saving fun. The 100 envelope challenge, the 52 week challenge and your own savings goals - all in one tracker with a dashboard that fills in as you go.
features: 100 envelope challenge with a colour grid that fills as you save
52 week challenge: forward or reverse, any starting amount
Up to 10 savings goals with targets, dates and 'needed per month'
Deposits log for your goals
Total saved across every challenge
Print-friendly dashboard to stick on the fridge

steps: Dashboard: choose your currency, the multiplier for the 100 envelope challenge and your 52-week starting amount.
100 Envelopes: each envelope holds its number x your multiplier (1 = up to 100, total 5,050). Pick any envelope, save that amount, and mark it Yes. Watch the grid on the Dashboard fill up.
52 Weeks: save the week's amount and mark it Yes. Choose Forward (small first) or Reverse (big first, easier at year end).
Savings Goals: name up to 10 goals with a target and date. Log each deposit on Deposits - progress bars and "needed per month" update.
Clear the sample ticks and deposits before you begin.
tips: Smaller budget? Set the envelope multiplier to 0.5 (total 2,525) or 0.25 (1,262.50).
Needed per month tells you exactly what to put aside to hit each goal on time.
Works in any currency. Print the Dashboard and stick it on the fridge for motivation.

small-business-bookkeeping.name: Small Business Bookkeeping 2027
small-business-bookkeeping.etsyTitle: Small Business Bookkeeping Spreadsheet 2027, Income & Expense Tracker, Profit and Loss Template, Excel & Google Sheets
small-business-bookkeeping.intro: Bookkeeping without the accounting software. Log money in and money out; the workbook builds your monthly profit & loss, totals each quarter for estimated tax payments and shows where your money goes.
features: Income and expense logs with category and payment-method dropdowns
Automatic monthly Profit & Loss by category
Quarter totals with a tax set-aside % you choose
Mileage log with your own rate per mile or km, flowing into the P&L
Receipt tracking: see how many receipts are still missing
Dashboard: income, expenses, net profit, margin, monthly chart and top expense categories

steps: Settings: type your business name, currency, year and the % of profit you set aside for tax. Edit the income and expense categories to match your business.
Record money in on Income and money out on Expenses - one row per transaction. Pick the category and payment method from the dropdowns.
Driving for work? Log trips on Mileage. The deduction uses the rate per mile/km you set in Settings and flows into your Profit & Loss.
Profit & Loss builds itself month by month. Dashboard shows year-to-date totals, quarter totals for estimated tax payments, and charts.
Delete the sample rows (white cells on Income, Expenses and Mileage) before you start.
tips: Mark Receipt = Yes once you've filed the receipt - the dashboard counts the ones still missing.
Quarter totals make estimated / provisional tax payments easy: profit x your set-aside %.
Category names are generic so they work in any country. Rename them to match your tax form (e.g. Schedule C or self-assessment boxes).
This workbook organises your numbers. It isn't tax advice - check deductibility rules with an accountant.

wedding-budget-planner.name: Wedding Budget Planner
wedding-budget-planner.etsyTitle: Wedding Budget Planner Spreadsheet, Wedding Planner Template with Guest List & RSVP, Vendor Payments, Excel & Google Sheets
wedding-budget-planner.intro: Plan your wedding without the stress of scattered notes. Set your total budget and the planner splits it across 15 categories using typical percentages. Add vendors with deposits and due dates and you'll always know what's paid, what's due next and what's left.
features: Dashboard: days to go, budget, committed, paid, left in budget, cost per guest
Budget split by suggested percentages, fully editable
Vendor payments with deposits, due dates and overdue warnings
Guest list with RSVP, meal choice, table, gift and thank-you tracking
Planning checklist with due dates counted back from your wedding day
Planned vs committed chart for every category

sheets.name: Dashboard
sheets.what: countdown, budget vs spent, upcoming payments, RSVPs and meals

sheets.name: Budget
sheets.what: planned vs committed vs paid for every category

sheets.name: Vendors
sheets.what: suppliers, deposits, final payments and due dates

sheets.name: Guest List
sheets.what: invites, RSVPs, meals, tables and thank-you notes

sheets.what: a 12-month planning timeline counted back from your date

steps: Dashboard: type your names, wedding date, total budget and currency in the pink boxes. The countdown starts straight away.
Budget: suggested percentages split your total budget across 15 categories. Change any planned amount or category name.
Vendors: add each supplier with its category, total cost, deposit and due dates. Mark deposits and final payments as paid - spending and "still to pay" update everywhere.
Guest List: add guests, how many people each invite covers, RSVP and meal choice. Dashboard counts confirmed guests and meals for your caterer.
Checklist: due dates count back from your wedding day. Mark tasks Done to see your progress.
Clear the sample data (white cells on Vendors, Guest List and Checklist) when you're ready.
tips: Cost per guest = what you've committed to vendors divided by confirmed guests - handy when deciding on numbers.
Keep 5-10% as contingency - small extras always appear in the last month.
Upcoming payments on the Dashboard shows the next deposits and balances due, with overdue ones in red.
Share it: upload the Google Sheets version to Drive and share it with your partner or planner so you both edit the same file.
